relationships.subject: IL-6
relationships.evidence_quote: cytokine-mediated JAK/STAT signalling, particularly IL-6/STAT3, integrates signals from immune cells, ferroptotic processes, and microbial metabolites

relationships.subject: ferroptosis
relationships.evidence_quote: the microbiota-ferroptosis-JAK/STAT interaction network forms an interconnected system that contributes to sustained inflammation

key_findings: Review links gut dysbiosis, iron-overload ferroptosis and IL-6/STAT3 JAK/STAT signalling in endometriosis inflammation; direct causal evidence limited.
